modifications: The same Tripo Triceratops and bake as the game (dist/assets/dinosaurs/triceratops-source.json), with two remake changes: the parts are welded into one closed skin rendered single-sided, and the finished Mosi is scaled uniformly to his real adult length of 8.5 m from nose to tail tip (one scale of 2.112 on the root node; skin, skeleton and clips grow together).

walk.note: The test scene walks him at 0.95 m/s, so the clip plays at about 0.77x: big animals step slower.

gameModel: dist/assets/dinosaurs/triceratops.glb (the game keeps the fitted size: the same command without length)
facePass: Eyes found in the colour map by remake/tools/bake/face.js (eyes.js) and written into the GLB as extras on the skinned mesh (face.eyes: per eye its centre, frame, outline and lid and lash colours, in bind space), for the eyelids the engine builds in code (engine/eyelids.js). Geometry and textures unchanged (2026-10-15).
mouthPass: A jaw cut by remake/tools/bake/mouth.js (2026-10-15, the owner: his beak opens a little when he talks, no teeth). His beak is one Tripo part and his lower jaw belongs to the head part, so the pass splits the triangles along his mouth line (given in the head frame, read off a side view: the top of the khaki jaw band, then between the upper and lower beak to the hook) in front of f = 0.2 m, gives the jaw side its own vertices there, adds a Jaw bone under the Head at the hinge, blends the jaw in from the hinge to the cut with six rounds of smoothing, fills the mouth with a pocket (palate and tongue painted into a free corner of the colour map; 1,176 triangles) and writes face.mouth.talk = 7 (degrees the beak opens at the loudest syllable). Re-exported with GLTFExporter (textures 1024 JPEG), node names kept. The game's dist triceratops.glb is untouched.
passes: bakeCommand, then faceCommand, then mouthCommand (the face pass finds the eyes the mouth pass takes its frame from).
